latest.text: I love it, it's the only thing like it out there. latest.author: Phosarite
latest.text: This is the best games launcher/ menu replacement I can find. Theres also not very many options. It desperately needs a ui and file management update. It reads some dlc and updates/ some other files as games and homebrew so you end up with a bunch of random icons pretending to be your games. Also the icons/ game cases look very bad. Low effort "cases" are just box art png with "ps5" or "gc" written on the top on colored stripe. Box art is low quality often.

latest.author: skipperbent
latest.text: This latest update already looks way more polished, very impressive work and nice touch with the platform cover-labels. May i suggest to group all games together, and then offer a filter button instead of having multiple tabs and sub-tabs for each game platform - it keeps it nice and tidy. The filter button could also have the option to filter not only by platform, but genre, year, publisher etc. Haha cant wait to put a custom background on, been waiting long for this feature in particular 🔥🔥😆…

latest.text: Thank you for the suggestion and feedback! We'll definitely add those features so you can change the bg image! We already added some alternative covers in the newest update that should look better and also have options for custom ones
